summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu delivered a confrontational UN speech threatening the Iranian regime's downfall and criticizing Qatar and Turkey, prompting a mass delegate walkout. Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi revealed a proposal to the US to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume nuclear talks within seven days based on the Islamabad understanding. Hezbollah ambushed an Israeli force at Ali al-Taher hill causing casualties, while Saudi air defenses intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Mecca, Taif, and Yanbu. (Source: @VahidOnline/78518, @VahidOnline/78520, @naya_foriraq/91543, @VahidOnline/78509)

Saudi Civil Defense intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Mecca, Taif, and Yanbu. (Source: @VahidOnline/78509)
IRGC spokesperson warns of 'different weapons' if new attack occurs. (Source: @kianmeli1/92470)
Civil aviation halted between Najaf International Airport and Iran. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91540)

Hezbollah ambushed an Israeli force at Ali al-Taher hill causing casualties, while Saudi air defenses intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles targeting Mecca, Taif, and Yanbu. (Source: @VahidOnline/78518, @VahidOnline/78520, @naya_foriraq/91543, @VahidOnline/78509)

points: IRGC spokesperson stated that in case of a new attack, Iran will employ 'different weapons,' signaling potential escalation in weaponry. (Source: @kianmeli1/92470)

Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced Iran has proposed to the US via intermediaries to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume negotiations for a 'final agreement,' requiring US compliance within seven days based on the Islamabad understanding. (Source: @VahidOnline/78520)
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam in New York during UNGA, indicating continued diplomatic coordination. (Source: @asafroz/53771)
Former CIA officer John Kiriakou claimed Israel recruited thousands of Afghan refugees in Iran for espionage at $100 each, exploiting their lack of Iranian citizenship. (Source: @kianmeli1/92472)
Civil aviation flights between Najaf International Airport and Iran have been halted, according to Iraqi sources. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91540)

Mohammad Mokhber, advisor to the Supreme Leader, declared that flight rights in the region must be equal for all or none, warning that if Iran is denied airport services, no regional country will have them. (Source: @SharghDaily/185684)

Prime Minister Netanyahu addressed the UN General Assembly, threatening the Iranian regime's downfall, labeling walkout delegates as 'cowardly immoral,' and accusing Qatar of hosting Hamas and Turkey's Erdogan of occupying northern Cyprus and seeking to occupy Syria. (Source: @VahidOnline/78518)

The Israeli government's official mapping site govmap uncensored previously blurred sections of the Gaza Strip, revealing military positions in high definition, first noted by open-source researchers. (Source: @manniefabian/59231)
Two reserve soldiers, Staff Sgt. Nadav Kali (24) and Staff Sgt. Ofek Moalem (23), from Battalion 7007, Brigade 16, were killed in Gaza during combat operations. (Source: @yediotnews25/135342)

An operational accident in northern Gaza killed the same two reservists when a 'Bat' explosive drone returned to their position and detonated while they handled it, prompting IDF to suspend all Bat drone operations pending technical investigation. (Source: @inon_yttach/10061)
Israeli state aircraft 'Kanaf Tzion' (B763, registration 4X-ISR) was tracked flying over Palestine at 4,975 feet, indicating high-level movement. (Source: @redlinkleb/44923)
Hostile warplanes were reported flying in northern occupied Palestine, per Lebanese monitoring channel. (Source: @redlinkleb/44969)

IDF Central Command documented preparations for operating Division 98 headquarters in the Judea and Samaria brigades area, signaling increased West Bank operational posture. (Source: @idf_telegram/25203)

Two IDF reservists from Battalion 7007, Brigade 16 died in northern Gaza after a 'Bat' loitering munition returned to their outpost and exploded during handling, leading to a suspension of all such drone operations. (Source: @inon_yttach/10061)

The IDF Chief of Staff ordered a halt to all activities with 'Bat' and other explosive drones pending technical investigation, including examination of possible enemy electronic warfare interference. (Source: @inon_yttach/10061)
Israeli mapping platform govmap revealed high-definition locations of military positions across the Gaza Strip after uncensoring previously blurred areas. (Source: @manniefabian/59231)
Security forces sealed the home of the terrorist who carried out the Neve Tzuf shooting attack earlier this week, which killed Netanel Shukrun. (Source: @N12chat/227065)
IDF Central Command is preparing to activate Division 98 headquarters in the Judea and Samaria brigades sector, indicating a structural reinforcement in the West Bank. (Source: @idf_telegram/25203)
Hezbollah ambushed an Israeli force at Ali al-Taher hill, with Israeli media broadcasting exclusive footage showing casualties among the Israeli troops. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91543)
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam in New York, underscoring Tehran-Beirut coordination during UNGA. (Source: @asafroz/53771)
A Lebanese monitoring channel urged the public to report any hostile activity, including drones or warplanes, via dedicated bots to strengthen the internal front. (Source: @redlinkleb/44906)
Four artillery shells targeted Wadi al-Khanazir on the outskirts of Qusayr town, an area near the Lebanon-Syria border. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394765)
Civil aviation between Najaf International Airport and Iran has been halted, according to Iraqi sources. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91540)
Four artillery shells struck Wadi al-Khanazir near Qusayr, a town on the Syrian side of the Lebanon-Syria border, indicating ongoing border tensions. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/394765)
Commentary suggests the Islamic Republic is losing ground in Iraq, referencing past anti-Iran chants in Baghdad and Najaf. (Source: @shin_persian/10427)
Iranian delegation's seating arrangement at the UN during Netanyahu's speech was photographed, showing diplomatic presence. (Source: @naya_foriraq/91514)

Saudi Civil Defense issued a warning of a renewed attempt to attack Mecca, later cancelled; simultaneously, the Saudi-led coalition intercepted six Houthi ballistic missiles and neutralized attempts targeting Taif and Yanbu. (Source: @VahidOnline/78509)
Persian Gulf states are reportedly urging the United States to maintain pressure on the Islamic Republic, per Wall Street Journal reporting. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81456)

Mohammad Mokhber warned that if Iran is denied flight and airport services, no country in the region will enjoy them, framing aviation access as a collective regional issue. (Source: @SharghDaily/185684)
